body_model.motion: translation only; fixed orientation; no angular velocity

coordinate_field.encoding: {a,b} means a+b*sqrt(2), with a,b exact rational strings
coordinate_field.name: Q(sqrt(2))

model.event_rule: globally least positive exact time; all same-time active constraints form one batch
model.invariants: kinetic energy preserved in all resolved batches; pair-only body momentum preserved; with walls, body momentum change equals wall impulse on bodies
model.name: hard-octagons-L4-N3
model.ordinary_pair_requirement: exactly one active face with strictly positive tangent edge overlap; corners are terminal UNKNOWN_CORNER
model.simultaneous_policy: disjoint pair plus independent wall contacts are allowed; any shared-body component is terminal REJECT_SHARED_BODY

independent_check_contract.independence: Checker accepts this certificate as its sole data input and must not import or invoke the producer.
independent_check_contract.row_contract: Each row stores full exact pre-event and post-event states at row.time. Checker recomputes global next batch from pre, requires exact event-set and post-state equality, tests strict positive pair-edge overlap, and checks conservation.
independent_check_contract.ternary_extraction: Read only ledger events. Retain every body-body pair event, including one in a disjoint pair+wall mixed batch. Ignore wall-only events. Map P0/P1,P1/P2,P0/P2 over all 6 label permutations to lexicographically least ternary word.
